patches.title: Start at Countertop Two
patches.principle: Begin search at countertop 2, then move to countertop 1 before other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a task when multiple countertops are present.

patches.title: Take Visible Target First
patches.principle: If you see the goal object on an open surface, pick it up immediately without delay.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is visible and you are on its surface.

patches.title: Direct Path After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up an object, go directly to the transformation or destination without intermediate stops.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs to be transformed or placed.
